name: Homuha Kouzuki
source:
Kou’s twin sister and resident tsundere vampire. Beneath her cold insults and outbursts of violence, she is actually quite naive and innocent. There was once a time when she decided that her future occupation would be “Onii-chan’s bride”, but those days have long since passed… Or have they? Also, she does not approve of lewd things.

[From [url=http://homuha.weebly.com/]official site[/url]]
